The planet [[Thule/Legends|Thule]] was home to an expansive '''[[Armory/Legends|armory]]''' complex that lay some forty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] outside the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Hurom]].<ref name="GatORW" />

This complex contained facilities ranging from weapons caches housing racks of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and [[Blaster pistol/Legends|pistols]] of every model to archives in which plans for [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] and vehicles were catalogued.<ref name="GatORW" /> One particularly fortified facility near the center of the complex was used exclusively to store [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]], [[Power cell/Legends|power packs]], and other components employed in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] construction.<ref name="GatORW" />

The armory was notable for being the location at which the [[Dark Reaper]], an ancient superweapon of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]],<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> was assembled during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].<ref name="KOTORCG" /> The weapon was initially constructed in one of the armory's hangars<ref name="GatORW" /> before eventually being disassembled and relocated to [[Kesiak]]<ref name="TCWVG">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref> a millennium later by an invading [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] task force during the [[Battle of Thule (Great Sith War)|Battle of Thule]].<ref name="TCSWE168">{{CSWECite|I|168|Dark Reaper}}</ref>
